searchText: https://ssoeborg.substack.com/p/proof-of-work-accelerates-inflation Or, you know, if they hadn't implemented a shrinking supply the price would've stayed low. But my basic reasoning skills are known to be lacking. even if the block reward stays constant it gets deluded over time. besides limited supply is not the innovation of crypto. its the trustlessness. BTC would have gotten to $50k regardless if it printed 50 BTC every 10 minutes or not imo. for example dogecoin has a fixed block reward. Its 10,000 doge. and it will always be 10,000 doge per block. And it has gone up in price alot lately. i am predicting that doge will have stronger PoW than bitcoin in the future btw Anyway, 50 BTC created every 10 minutes when the total supply is only 1,000,000 is bigger inflation than 50 BTC created every 10 minute if the total supply is 20 million Please remember, this is an Ethereum research and development discord server. It isn't the right place to speculate about crypto-currency prices. > deluded Freudian slip? right proof of work is going away anyway 🙂 Either way I'm interested in seeing what will happen when transaction fees really start to dominate some chains EIP-1559 "closed" this security hole for Ethereum (afaik), but I don't think Bitcoin will go the same way 1559 did not fully resolve the issue on Ethereum, just mitigated it in some scenarios. chains who will rely on transaction fees for security might not have very big market caps unless they end up with the kinds of fees Ethereum currently has. What else remains besides doubly full blocks resulting in possible reorgs then <@!301186049323958275> ? The selfish mining problem occurs anytime profit from transactions in a block exceeds block reward in a significant way. That still occurs today, just not as often. A few months ago it occurred basically all the time (Feb to early April), and now it's really rather rare. I'd say that makes long reorgs much more unlikely, short ones are still possible though. (Looking at https://etherchain.org/charts/feeMiningReward exceeding ~12k, which would be the daily cumulative block reward) how quickly could ETH switch to 40M/80M blocks if the idea started gaining traction? it would protect ETHs ERC20 network effects cause a v-shaped recovery maybe. Hi ladies and gents. I love the community and love the project. Is anyone here based in Tulsa Oklahoma?
